purpose: Engineering qualification and reproducibility, not new evidence of Rust expertise

frozen_regression.acceptance: All frozen predictions and checkpoint hashes must reproduce exactly

configurable_trainer.selection: Mean validation NLL over all three seeds; declared arm order breaks ties
configurable_trainer.test: Selected arm only, after validation selection; previously observed test set

external_panel.purpose: Qualify acquisition, repository grouping and compiler labels

performance.rule: Report regressions and benefits for the measured shapes only; no trading-latency extrapolation

remote.execution: bounded CPU job, pinned source commit, separate output directory
